annotations.title: New supply, units vs houses, by mesh block (by suburb)

description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Supply 2km' map layer (explorer) in the
Development section.

New dwellings (last 24 months) split units vs houses. `summary` counts each new
building once inside the suburb; each mesh block row counts new dwellings within
500 m of the block centre, so block rows overlap and must not be summed.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
